verdict.rationale: Versioning, review, and rollback of agent configurations is a fair axis for an agent-building platform, but the evidence pack never documents agent versions, change history, review or approval of changes, or rollback. Pre-deploy agent testing and management through the CLI, API or MCP server are related features, not versioning or rollback, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
